text: {"name":"llc_set_connection","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Queues a requested connection if a switch is already pending; otherwise updates the active connection and processes the connection command.","subsystem":"llc","var_renames":{"result":"requested_connection","v1":"llc_context","v3":"current_connection","v8":"connection_command_payload"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Connection state marker, set to 4 for an already-active connection or 2 when starting a switch."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Connection state byte copied into an outgoing notification unless its value is 3."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"Pointer to the currently active connection context."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Pending connection context to apply after the current command completes."}]}
